items.title: Fanny and Layla, cosplay photo 1
items.alt: Cosplayers dressed as Fanny and Layla pose close together in a night hall, each with a large mechanical weapon.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the first reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Fanny and Layla, cosplay photo 2
items.alt: Cosplayers dressed as Layla and Fanny pose in a night hall, Layla in front with a large white cannon that crackles with lightning and Fanny leaping behind her.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the first reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Fanny and Layla, cosplay photo 3
items.alt: Cosplayers dressed as Fanny and Layla stand back to back, Fanny with a long blade and Layla with a white weapon that crackles with lightning.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the first reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Fanny and Layla, cosplay photo 4
items.alt: Cosplayers dressed as Layla and Fanny pose in a smoky hall full of sparks, Layla jumping with a huge blade and Fanny posing on the right.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the first reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Layla, cosplay photo 1
items.alt: A cosplayer dressed as Layla poses with one hand raised beside her head and a large white weapon below her, her long pink twin tails streaming to the left.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the second reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Layla, cosplay photo 2
items.alt: A cosplayer dressed as Layla is seen from behind, looking back over her shoulder and raising a huge white blade that crackles with lightning.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the second reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Layla, cosplay photo 3
items.alt: A cosplayer dressed as Layla faces the camera with her long pink twin tails swept back and a large white weapon in front of her, with mist behind.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the second reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Layla, cosplay photo 4
items.alt: A cosplayer dressed as Layla jumps with a huge white blade held up beside her face, her long pink twin tails flying to the right.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the second reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Fanny, cosplay photo 1
items.alt: A cosplayer dressed as Fanny leaps with a blade raised high, a streak of blue light in the foreground and white specks in the air.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the third reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Fanny, cosplay photo 2
items.alt: A cosplayer dressed as Fanny looks at the camera and holds a long blade low across her body in a dark, hazy room.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the third reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Fanny, cosplay photo 3
items.alt: A cosplayer dressed as Fanny crouches in a wide stance with two glowing blades, with sparks and smoke behind her.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the third reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.

items.title: Fanny, cosplay photo 4
items.alt: A cosplayer dressed as Fanny twists in the air with a glowing blade, wrapped in a ribbon of blue light and white specks.

credit.note: Posted by the official Mobile Legends: Bang Bang account as the third reveal of its The Aspirants cosplay photos.
